data.action: 操控轮椅穿行街角，膝上放着装满点心的纸袋
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 拉特兰街角】拉特兰充满巴洛克风情的阳光街角，蕾缪安从容地操控着电动轮椅穿行在石砖路上，膝盖上放着一大袋刚出炉的苹果肉桂馅饼。看到身旁的你，她露出知性优雅的微笑——「能天使刚才又把甜品店的招牌炸飞了呢……趁她还在被审判官说教，我们先把这袋馅饼分着吃了吧。」
data.promptProse: Lemuen guides her electric wheelchair along Laterano's cobblestones with one hand on the joystick, a bag of apple-cinnamon pies balanced on her lap blanket. Dark overcoat, white shirt and black tie remain beneath her bright halo as she turns knowingly toward the viewer. The tracking medium view follows baroque shopfronts and archways behind. Afternoon daylight catches the paper bag and chair edges, with soft shadows between cobbles and under the passing arches.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 拉特兰街角
